title: Backup Freshness Alert (system_check source)
description: AUTHORITATIVE shape for a system_check alert. This schema is the single source of truth for the diagnostic-code set; design prose and task lists reference it rather than re-enumerating it. Every field below was checked against WorkflowAlertEnvelopeV1 in src/contracts/workflow_alert_models.py:218-346 — that model is a StrictModel (extra='forbid'), so a field this schema invents is rejected at construction, and a field the model requires but this schema omits produces a document the model will not accept.

event_key.description: Lowercase-and-digits only: WorkflowEventKey is ^[a-z0-9:_-]+$, so an ISO-8601 stamp would be rejected. Suffix is the check-window start as epoch seconds — see design A10 for the window definition and why this is a stable key rather than a wall-clock read.

outcome.description: Subset of the model's Literal. 'reconciled' is reserved for reconciliation sources; 'partial'/'zero_items' are operation-shaped.

operation_id.description: Required-but-null. The model declares operation_id with no default, so it must be PRESENT; a system check has no operation, so it is explicitly null rather than synthesized.

attempt.description: The model types attempt as int >= 1 — NOT nullable. The existing non-operation branch pins it to 1 ('reconciliation alerts use immutable attempt 1'); the system_check branch mirrors that, since a system check has no retry identity.

diagnostic_url.description: https only — the model rejects other schemes and the producer hardcodes https (workflow_terminal_event_service.py:568). The UUID MUST equal event_id: the existing non-operation branch asserts path == /api/v1/workflow-terminal-events/{event_id}. Reuses this already-allowlisted route instead of adding /api/v1/health/backup.

source_keys.description: Empty for a system check — no ingestion sources are involved. Required by the model, so present-and-empty rather than omitted.

counts.description: WorkflowAlertCounts is itself a StrictModel with seven closed, optional fields. The four backup fields below do NOT exist on it today and are part of the widening (design A9) — without that, any backup tally here is rejected by extra='forbid'.

codes.description: AUTHORITATIVE code set. Six codes. WorkflowAlertDiagnosticCode must be widened to admit exactly these; design and tasks reference this list rather than restating it, because enumerating it in three places is what caused the count to drift across two review rounds.
